_about: Curated P0 decisions, keyed by page file. serverPage: the page id whose PAGE_VIEWS entry this file feeds. rename: move a scanned view to another name (report/detail pages share their server page with the list page). views.<v>.replace drops the scan for that view; add/drop adjust it; every added table carries its reason.

Company_ValleyFoods_MfgOrderView.html._note: single-order page served under vf_mfg_orders; everything on it is one detail view

Company_ValleyFoods_HR_Emp.html._note: The page starts three watches in a loop and each watchPage call stops the previous one, so only vf_hr_shifts is polled today. Its PAGE_VIEWS entry therefore carries every tab's tables; the page calls setView('tab:<TAB>') in render().

add.valley_employee_status: the status tab lists status rows
add.valley_employee_info: the status tab shows the employee name

add.legal_employee_info: the salaries tab shows the employee name
